correctness.rationale: The exact Walsh polynomial (1) gives Bernoulli(1/4) marginals and orthogonal degree-two supports for distinct triangles. Three different supports have a nonzero product expectation only for the star of three shared edges on four vertices, namely three K4 faces; the known tetrahedral orientation obstruction yields -1/64. Expand the third cumulant to obtain 3/32 times the diagonal weighted cubes and -3/32 times each unordered exceptional weighted triple. The standalone exact checker covers every orientation of 1,098 labelled graphs of orders two through five, 1,004 distinct-triangle triples and weighted/unweighted identities. The analytic argument covers all graph orders; finite checks alone do not.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Moon/Moran already cover the n-vertex complete graph numerical third moment, explicitly excluded from novelty. Allen et al handle asymptotic counts of directed-cycle-free orientations of random underlying graphs; this does not imply an exact weighted third tensor on every fixed graph. Reiher et al give deterministic tetrahedral forbidden pattern, not the full 3-wise independence statement away from it.

Moon gives complete-tournament aggregate third moment and Reiher gives its K4 impossibility, but neither inspected text states the arbitrary-graph local three-way law. originality.rationale: The complete-graph third moment is expressly classical (Moon Ch. 6 Exercise 3 cites Moran 1947); the K4 three-cycles impossibility is explicitly in Reiher et al Example 1.4. The claim is the arbitrary-fixed-graph full three-indicator dependence classification, mixed cumulant support, and deterministic weighted formula; neither classical special case implies these. The analogous cyclic-order query shattering problem concerns a cyclic total order, not independent edge directions. Novelty remains qualified by older possibly unindexed general orientation results.
residual_risks: Older tournament dependency graph literature might already state the arbitrary-underlying-graph mixed-cumulant tensor.
Complete-graph numerical third moment and tetrahedral no-three-cycles fact are known, so novelty excludes them.
A separate edge-sign balance statistic also recovers K4 using its fourth cumulant, but this does not establish the orientation-based three-way law.

value.rationale: The natural full indicator process is pairwise independent even though not generally independent; the theorem locates the exact first-order three-body obstruction and gives a sharp K4-free iff criterion. Weighted third cumulants provide a complete localized statistical motif signature for every triangle; unweighted second and third cumulants recover triangle and K4 counts from randomized orientations. This is broader than a trivial complete-tournament moment substitution.
